title: wave-hologram: off-axis digital holography with measured focus
description:
WaveHolo is an open-source Python package for end-to-end digital holography. It records an off-axis hologram, reconstructs the object field by numerical back-propagation (angular-spectrum method), and measures the focus distance instead of assuming it.

As of v0.1.3 it was validated against logged stage positions on 530 real microscope holograms. The v0.1.5 line adds a vectorized pair-spectrum solver for realness sweeps, a browser-only Pyodide/NetCDF research sandbox, and a real-data benchmark harness.

The package is a single flat module (not on PyPI). License: AGPL-3.0-only.

Code: https://github.com/sparkainlp-x/waveholo
